query:
UPDATE peers
                    SET active = FALSE
                    WHERE (user_id, torrent_id, peer_id) IN (
                        SELECT t.user_id, t.torrent_id, t.peer_id
                        FROM (
                            SELECT * FROM unnest(
                                $1::int[],
                                $2::int[],
                                $3::bytea[]
                            ) AS t(user_id, torrent_id, peer_id)
                        ) AS t
                    )
                    -- stored as timestamp without time zone in UTC
                    AND updated_at < ($4::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
